system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
you can define a subclass of `ToolMessage` (pydantic based)
and it is transpiled into system prompt instructions for the tool.
system_prompt_style.note: System message composed from user system_message plus enabled-tool instructions; inferred from docs prose.

env_context_strategy.note: General framework; no default environment-context mechanism for a repository. RAG (DocChatAgent) is opt-in. No source files are in the bundle.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Langroid tries to shorten the message history by dropping early messages
context_compaction.note: Large tool result truncation is available via optional ToolMessage params (0.22.0).

observation_format.note: Multimodal inputs (0.52.0) are for user input, not tool observations.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
Langroid supports OpenAI's [function calling](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/gpt/function-calling), as
well as an equivalent `ToolMessage` mechanism which works with
any LLM, not just OpenAI's.
tool_call_format.note: JSON ToolMessage is the native mechanism. XMLToolMessage is opt-in.

tool_count.note: Tools are user-enabled via enable_message. No default tool list is visible in the bundle.

edit_primitive.note: README mentions an EditTool in the plugin text, but its definition is not in the evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote:
Function calling and tools have the same developer-facing interface, implemented
using [Pydantic](https://docs.pydantic.dev/latest/)
tool_schema_source.note: MCP tool adapter converts server tools to ToolMessage.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP Support: Allow any LLM-Agent to leverage MCP Servers via Langroid's simple

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: manages iteration over an Agent's responder methods
loop_primitives.note: The Task loop cycles over LLM, agent (tool handler) and user responders.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: A Task class wraps an Agent, gives the agent instructions
planning_granularity.note: The plan-subtasks and planner-workflow examples exist but are not the default.

multi_agent_topology.note: Hierarchical sub-tasks are reachable via add_sub_task.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: enables agents to spawn sub-agents with specific tools and configurations
delegation_mechanism.note: The default is none. subagent_spawn is reachable via TaskTool, and sub-task delegation via add_sub_task.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:
the task loop waits for user input after
either the `llm_response` or `agent_response` (typically a tool-handling response)
returns a valid response.
human_in_loop.note: interactive=True is the default. Closest values chosen; the user steers each turn.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The `Agent` class encapsulates LLM conversation state

long_term_memory.note: Vector stores are opt-in for RAG over documents, not agent memory. No config source is in the bundle.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Currently there is no built-in Langroid mechanism for this
state_persistence.note: Pickling message_history is a manual workaround. JSON chat-history snapshots were added in 0.66.0.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: ensures that tool generation errors are sent back to the LLM so it retries the generation
retry_policy.note: Only step-level requery is present; there is no task-level retry.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
`Task.run(), Task.run_async(), run_batch_tasks` have `max_cost`
and `max_tokens` params to exit when tokens or cost exceed a limit.
termination_condition.note: The README also cites infinite-loop detection, done_sequences, and turns.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Langroid supports [Redis](https://redis.com/try-free/) to cache LLM responses.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
the Agent's function-handling method
executes the code and returns the answer.
execution_isolation.note: Tool handlers run in-process as Python methods.

tracing.evidence_quote:
Langroid generates detailed logs of multi-agent interactions and
maintains provenance/lineage of messages
tracing.note: An HTML logger was added in 0.57.0.

guardrails.note: The docs list code-injection-protection and tool-origin-taint notes, but their contents are not in the bundle.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Python framework to easily build LLM-powered applications

open_source.note: The licence text is not shown.
